summary: Verified new sortable-header feature across all requested tables — backend server-side sort on /api/audit-logs + frontend client-side sort for Users, Offices, Broadcast, Database Backup, and Branding→Sitemap. Backend: created /app/backend/tests/test_audit_sort.py (15 tests, 15 passed) covering sort_by ∈ {created_at,actor,action,entity_type,summary} × sort_dir ∈ {asc,desc}, invalid sort_by fallback (200 → created_at desc), X-Total-Count invariance across sort, global (cross-page) ordering, and sort combined with entity_type/q/date_from filters. Frontend: /audit-log renders 5 sortable header buttons (data-testid sort-created_at/actor/action/entity_type/summary), Detail column is not sortable; clicking sort-actor triggers 2 requests with sort_by=actor toggling sort_dir=asc then desc (server-side confirmed via network interception). /broadcast exposes sort-label/description/status/last and toggles asc↔desc client-side (rows_asc reversed == rows_desc). /database exposes sort-filename/created_at/total/size. /branding→Sitemap exposes ONLY sort-path (no forbidden sort testids for change_freq/priority/enabled controls). /users thead contains 7 button headers: ['', Name, Email, Username, Role, Office, Password] — first empty header is the select-checkbox column (correctly not sortable); Name header clickable twice without errors. /offices thead contains 6 button headers: ['', Code, Name, Telephone, Address, Radius]. No console errors on any page. Everything matches the requirement spec.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py list_audit_logs correctly whitelists sort_by and falls back safely; json.dumps(default=str) defensive coercion protects against legacy nested BSON — good.
sortable-table.jsx useSortableRows uses localeCompare with numeric:true which handles Radius (numeric column) well; SortHead emits data-testid=sort-{key} consistently — good.
Users/Offices rely on TanStack SortableHeader (no data-testid). If future automated tests need stable selectors, consider adding data-testid to those header buttons too — minor, non-blocking.
seed_data_creation: Created 3 offices (SORT_TEST_<ts>_O0..O2) + 3 updates + 1 bulk-delete to generate audit rows with varied action/summary values; cleaned up in fixture teardown.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Sortable headers verified for Audit(server-side)/Users/Offices/Broadcast/Database/Branding-Sitemap. Roles page (/roles) is intentionally exempt (hierarchical tree). If new tables are added later, verify SortHead+useSortableRows wired up and data-testid=sort-{key} present, and that controls/switches/selects and Actions/Detail/Select columns remain excluded from sorting per user requirement.
